parts.script:
Alice: Hey Mark, have you thought about what we should do this weekend? I was thinking we could go hiking. 
Mark: That's a great idea! I've heard there’s a beautiful trail up in the Silver Mountains. 
Alice: Perfect! We could leave early Saturday morning and maybe have a picnic there. 
Mark: Sounds like a plan! Do you think we need to bring anything special? 
Alice: Definitely some water and snacks. Also, I think we should take a first aid kit, just in case. 
Mark: Good thinking! Should we invite Sarah too? 
Alice: Yeah, she would love it. I’ll text her. What time do you want to meet? 
Mark: How about 7 AM? That way, we can avoid the heat and have plenty of time to enjoy the hike. 
Alice: 7 AM it is! I can pick you up. 
Mark: Great! I’m looking forward to it! 
Alice: Me too! It's going to be fun!
